title: Qt: Add a "Redissect Packets" View menu item
description:
Add an action that triggers a redissection of all packets. Unlike
"Reload", this can be done during a live capture. This is useful for
dealing with DSBs that occur in a file after the packet records that
they are used for.

Ping #20558 (this is a manual fix)

@@ -1166,12 +1166,18 @@ The same sort of thing can happen when capturing over a remote connection, e.g.,
   is running, e.g., a new DHCP lease takes effect, Wireshark won’t notice it.
 
 // XXX Is this true for all or only for DNS info?
+// It varies a little bit, see wsug_files.adoc for some info. Some address
+// information files are read in addr_resolv_init, which is called by epan_new,
+// which happens when opening a new file or when redissecting.
+// VLAN and ipxnets are read on demand; ethers were read on demand prior to
+// 5.0 (93fd22eac32a62148147ce46716a74425fbdc823). At least some OSes (Windows)
+// can be pretty slow repeatedly trying to scan the file.
 
 Name resolution in the packet list is done while the list is filled. If a name
 can be resolved after a packet is added to the list, its former entry won’t be
 changed. As the name resolution results are cached, you can use
-menu:View[Reload] to rebuild the packet list with the correctly resolved names.
-However, this isn’t possible while a capture is in progress.
+menu:View[Redissect Packets] to rebuild the packet list with
+the correctly resolved names.
 
 // XXX Add information about the address editor frame (View -> Name Resolution -> Edit Resolved Name)

@@ -471,6 +471,8 @@ shows only the packet details and bytes of that packet, and will
 continue to do so even if another packet is selected in the main window.
 See <<ChWorkPacketSepView>> for details.
 
+|menu:Redissect Packets[]                           |                   |This menu item redissects the current packets. This can be useful if name resolution or decryption information has changed.
+
 |menu:Reload as File Format/Capture[]               |kbd:[Shift+Ctrl+F] |This menu item allows you to switch between viewing the list of frames contained in the current capture file (normal mode) and viewing its internal structure, if supported for the current file type.
 
 |menu:Reload[]                                      |kbd:[Ctrl+R]       |This menu item allows you to reload the current capture file.

@@ -196,6 +196,9 @@ for Arm64 and Intel. wsbuglink:17294[]
 
 * LibXml2 is now a required dependency.
 
+* The View menu has an option to Redissect Packets manually, which can be useful
+  when address resolution or decryption secrets have changed.
+
 === Removed Features and Support
 
 Wireshark no longer supports AirPcap and WinPcap.
